tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot observations carry the high-frequency sign-oscillation signature. Abstain rather than claim a stationary smooth law or fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Stationary Haldane, Temkin, or Michaelis–Menten model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid pilot reports high-frequency sign oscillation, so these smooth stationary mechanisms are not reliable for the target regime.
The reported oscillation signature already calls for scoped abstention under the decision rule.
The auxiliary measurement is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
